Presented in true walk-in condition, No. 47 Glenaan Road is a beautifully maintained and thoughtfully upgraded two-bedroom home offering bright, spacious accommodation and a host of desirable features. Extended to the rear and complemented by a converted attic, this superb property is ideal for first-time buyers,  or those seeking a turnkey home in a mature and convenient location.

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a comfortable living room and a spacious extended kitchen/dining area, creating the perfect space for modern family living and entertaining. Upstairs are two generous double bedrooms and a stylish family bathroom, while the converted attic provides a versatile additional room, ideal as a home office, playroom or guest accommodation (subject to the appropriate planning considerations). A second bathroom adds further convenience and flexibility.

Externally, the property benefits from off-street parking to the front, while the private rear garden features a substantial block-built shed, providing excellent storage or potential workshop space.

Located in a well-established residential area, No. 47 enjoys easy access to an excellent range of local amenities, including schools, shops, cafés, parks and excellent public transport links, with Dublin City Centre within easy reach.

Combining modern upgrades, generous living space and a highly convenient location, this exceptional home is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers. Early viewing is highly recommended.
